description: Use when you need evidence that a supplier or product is real. Evidence report for a supplier (name and/or website) or a product (GTIN/UPC or name) from free public sources (Wikidata, DNS, HTTPS/TLS, RDAP, GLEIF incl. parents, GTIN check digit, Open Food/Products/Beauty Facts). For suppliers it also screens the name against OFAC/UK/UN sanctions lists (possible match - manual review; never a clearance), validates an EU VAT number via VIES (vat_number) and queries keyless registries for FR, NO, CZ, FI and PL (country, registry_id; PL needs the KRS number). Each check is verified, unverified or contradictory with source and timestamp. Not an authenticity or fraud guarantee. PAID tool: call without x402_payment to get the payment requirements. Price: $0.10 per call. Paid in REAL USDC on Base mainnet (chain 8453) via x402.

country.description: Supplier country, ISO alpha-2 (e.g. DE, FR, NO, CZ, FI, PL).

registry_id.description: National registry id (needs country): SIREN/SIRET FR, org no. NO, IČO CZ.

subject.description: Supplier name, product name, or GTIN/UPC.

trial.description: Free trial instead of payment: a few calls per client per UTC day (shared across paid tools); result marked mode=trial.

vat_number.description: EU VAT number incl. prefix, e.g. DE811128135.

website.description: Claimed public website/domain (no port or credentials).

x402_payment.description: Base64 x402 v1 'exact' EIP-3009 payment payload for Base mainnet (REAL USDC on Base mainnet (chain 8453)). Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements as a tool error (structuredContent.accepts); sign them and call again with this argument. One payment funds exactly one call.
